entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A world where death and decay abound, home to undead fueled by hatred of the living, and where corpses are currency among necromancers and demons.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A polis that formerly oppressed the leonin.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: A people once oppressed by Meletis who occasionally hunt their old enemies as game; adversaries of Akros known for staunch ferocity.

entities.name: Skirk Ridge
entities.description: A place from which goblins poured like lava.

entities.name: Agmand Sarv
entities.description: An Azorius hussar who warns of a dangerous, avaricious figure.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A guild with hussars and an imperator.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A guild with an army of soldiers and respected mage-priests.

entities.name: Razzix
entities.description: A sparkmage.

entities.name: Split-Eye Coven
entities.description: Witches of Grixis who harvest vis from the living for their dark magics.

entities.name: Spear-Tribe

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker for whom the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

entities.name: Akros

entities.name: Cymede
entities.description: The queen of Akros.

entities.description: An orcish captain who orders volcano-balls loaded.

entities.description: A subordinate addressed by Stumphobbler Thuj.

entities.name: Jund

entities.name: Mardu

events.summary: A lone missionary marches on a grim pilgrimage through Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar.
events.quote: His mission has become a grim pilgrimage, a tour of the Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar.

relations.quote: Formerly oppressed by the polis of Meletis, leonin occasionally "mistake" their old enemies for game.
"The people of Akros must learn from our leonin adversaries.
Witches of the Split-Eye Coven speak of a future when Grixis will overflow with life energy.
